description: This file implements a comprehensive Android UI component 'SettingsSheet' using Jetpack Compose. It provides a detailed settings interface for device configuration, permissions, notification handling, location, data access, and preferences. The code interacts with Android system services for permissions, notifications, and roles, and manages a variety of state variables for user interface elements.

classes.name: InstalledApp
classes.description: Data class representing an installed application with label, package name, and system app flag.

methods.name: queryInstalledApps
methods.description: Queries the list of installed launcher apps and recent notification packages, returning a sorted list of InstalledApp objects.

methods.name: resolveNotificationCandidatePackages
methods.description: Combines configured, launcher, and recent packages into a set of candidate packages, excluding the app's own package.

methods.name: settingsTextFieldColors
methods.description: Returns color scheme for text fields in the settings UI.

methods.name: Modifier.settingsRowModifier
methods.description: Extension function to apply consistent styling to layout rows in settings.

methods.name: settingsPrimaryButtonColors
methods.description: Returns color scheme for primary buttons in settings.

methods.name: settingsDangerButtonColors
methods.description: Returns color scheme for danger-styled buttons in settings.

methods.name: openAppSettings
methods.description: Opens the application details in system settings.

methods.name: openNotificationListenerSettings
methods.description: Navigates to notification listener settings, fallback to app settings if needed.

methods.name: hasNotificationsPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has POST_NOTIFICATIONS permission (Android 13+).

methods.name: isNotificationListenerEnabled
methods.description: Checks if notification listener is enabled.

methods.name: hasMotionCapabilities
methods.description: Checks for available motion sensors (accelerometer or step counter).

methods.name: isAssistantRoleAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the device supports the role of Assistant.

methods.name: isAssistantRoleHeld
methods.description: Checks if the app currently holds the Assistant role.
